_comment: The one authored storylet of the Phase 2 slice (D-066; caps storylets: 1). STRUCTURE ONLY: its words in data/text/en.json are placeholders marked as such, the director writes them. Cast over tags (see sim/story/tags.gd): the mourner holds a memory of a comrade's death, the friend shares that memory (a relationship). Trigger: resting at the hub or a hamlet from day 1. Visible check: a d10 against difficulty 11, odds shown before the roll; the player picks who attempts (the mourner by resolve, the friend by presence). Both branches change state (a memory and experience): failing forward. Schema: data/schema/storylets.schema.json.
